inbox.assunto: Welcome to União Rondonópolis-MT, PAULO CORREA
inbox.corpo:
On behalf of the board, welcome to União Rondonópolis-MT. We play at Estádio Municipal de Cuiabá in Cuiabá, and this season we compete in the Série D.

Your squad ranks 5th of 6 on overall strength (61). The board's expectation is to secure the club's place in the division and build for the future.

You have our full support. Good luck.

You have 30 professionals available. No contract expires within the next 12 months.

The Sub-20 academy has 20 youngsters aged 15 to 20. Promotions to the first team are always your decision; players who turn 21 leave the academy.

The squad is in pre-season and fitness is still low. Set the weekly training schedule, balance workload and recovery, and avoid heavy sessions right before matches. I will report injuries and fitness problems here.
The club cash balance is $900,000. Wages are paid every week, so keep an eye on the payroll before signing players. I will send a monthly summary and warn you if the balance gets tight.

Our scouts follow the Sub-20 academy every month. Potential is shown as a star estimate — it is an opinion, not a guarantee, and it becomes more reliable as the players get older. A monthly development report will arrive here.
